notes.title: Updated Demo!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We just updated the Pin City Demo here on Steam as well as on Meta Quest Standalone for all of our Alpha-build playtesters there.

In this update:

We made sure the ball steering controls are consistent in both versions.
Updated the settings menu so that you can select to steer the ball using your throwing hand's joystick OR your throwing hand's primary button and rotating your hand (like you're turning a key!)
Added different skin tones for your VR hands. Currently it randomly cycles through the textures we've added each time you play through. There is also a "Randomize!" button in the Settings Menu.
Added new music.
Added new level transition animations.
Updated the spikes level animation.
Added some environmental props and optimized other props.
Small UI tweaks.

The demo for Pin City has its own store page, so feel free to leave a review there and let us know what you think! It means a lot to us. 

We hope you have been enjoying our demos. Development has been a little slow, but we are still pushing forward!

Thanks for playing!
Karen & Cole
Studio217
